subject.title: fix(gateway): detect unresolved env-var placeholders in gateway auth token

question: Should this TypeScript-only branch be retargeted or narrowed, or should a native macOS resolver PR carry the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101286?
rationale: Multiple contributor PRs overlap the same P0 issue, and this branch changes a TypeScript resolver while the source-reproducible failure remains in the native macOS resolver path.

options.title: Prefer a native macOS fix
options.body: Use a native resolver PR as the canonical path once proof is acceptable, then ask this branch to close or narrow to separate TypeScript hardening.

options.title: Retarget this branch
options.body: Ask this author to replace the TypeScript-only change with a native macOS resolver fix, Swift tests, and live proof.

options.title: Keep as TypeScript hardening
options.body: Treat this PR as separate resolver hardening only if it is decoupled from the macOS issue and aligned with the SecretRef grammar.

recommendation.title: Prefer a native macOS fix
recommendation.body: Use a native resolver PR as the canonical path once proof is acceptable, then ask this branch to close or narrow to separate TypeScript hardening.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is native macOS dashboard/gateway ownership and coordination among overlapping macOS fix PRs.
